name: Devin CLI
description: inference@1 agent provider devin-cli over devin acp.

permissionMode.title: Permission mode
permissionMode.description: Sent as modeId to session/set_mode when a session opens.

utilityModel.title: Utility model
utilityModel.description: Model for small side jobs such as naming sessions; may end in an effort (claude-haiku-5-5-low). Empty turns them off.

hideFusion.title: Hide Fusion models
hideFusion.description: Hides the fusion-* model variants from the model list.

hideAdaptive.title: Hide Adaptive
hideAdaptive.description: Hides the adaptive model from the model list.

denyKinds.title: Denied ACP kinds
denyKinds.description: ACP tool kinds Devin may never run when it asks permission, e.g. execute.

command.title: ACP command
command.description: Command used to start the Devin ACP child. Default: devin acp. Needs a valet restart.

refusalFallback.title: Refusal fallbacks
refusalFallback.description: Models passed as --refusal-fallback when the ACP child starts. Needs a valet restart.

models.title: Model list
models.description: Replaces the live devin models list. Rename or hide models on the Models page instead.
